domain_lenses.description: Interpret primitive data through the vocabulary and concerns of a specific design domain.

lenses.summary: Brand personality, positioning, recognition assets, system potential, competitive differentiation
Shelf presence, purchase hierarchy, production methods, unboxing experience, sustainability
Component architecture, interaction affordances, layout system, accessibility, UX quality
Reading experience, typographic voice, visual storytelling, text-image relationship, publication system
Attention mechanics, persuasion architecture, CTA analysis, message hierarchy, campaign logic
Scale and distance, spatial integration, wayfinding, material/fabrication, lighting
Implied movement, temporal signals, animation potential, motion personality, choreography
Lighting strategy, lens/optics, composition, color grading, mood/atmosphere, briefing
Mark-making, rendering approach, narrative content, technique, system replicability

style_lenses.description: Interpret primitive data as aesthetic identity, emotional effect, and transferable taste.

lenses.summary: Core aesthetic DNA, mood, emotional signature, sensory translation, cultural positioning, designer brief
Emotional spectrum, psychological space, energy mapping, trust/authority, emotional mechanics
Source-to-target translation: color, typography, spatial, material, imagery, interaction, do/don't rules

structural_lenses.description: Pure formal analysis independent of domain, style, or emotion. The grammar of visual arrangement.

lenses.summary: Geometric skeleton, axis system, proportions, visual weight, containment, movement, figure-ground
Color/typography/spacing/shape tokens, component patterns, constraint rules, implementation-ready specs
Cross-image consensus, variance, clusters, outliers, collection DNA, directional signals
Per-primitive similarity scoring, shared principles, key differences, pairing assessment

routing_rules.description: How user intent maps to lens activation. Multiple lenses can be activated simultaneously.
routing_rules.default_behavior: If no specific domain or intent is detected, activate aesthetic_fingerprint as the default style lens.
routing_rules.broad_intent_handling: If intent is very broad (e.g. 'analyze this'), activate aesthetic_fingerprint + the most relevant domain lens based on image content detection from primitives.
routing_rules.multi_lens_composition: Lenses are fully composable. A request like 'help me apply this packaging style to a website' activates packaging_design + taste_transfer (with target=website).

example_routings.intent: I love this illustration style and want to use it for my brand
What's the overall vibe of my collection?
How are these two images similar?
I want to make a packaging design inspired by these
Extract a color palette and type system from this
